assumptions: Observed arithmetic mean magnitude is the scoring statistic; tails and candidate rates are separate diagnostics, not extra penalties.
Reciprocal normalization is a new experimental monotone mapping: zero maps to100 and an observed mean equal to the reference maps to50. These anchors do not define a grade or safety boundary.
A/J/R reference values are identical for every allowed trip and frozen at full historical precision; no per-trip fitting.
35/40/25 baseline weights are user-proposed experimental values, not validated standards.
No GPS/event/direct subjective score component; no assumption of equal sensor reliability or vehicle type.
Score covers observed motion only; missing time is neither imputed nor treated as smooth.
All context multipliers are1 because differential numerical effects are unsupported; normalized contextual weights equal baseline weights for complete feedback.
Confidence is descriptive and separate from numerical smoothness; no inference of driver ability or road safety.

confidence.approach: Report measured coverage, recording length, GPS availability and categorical placement/movement uncertainty without invented cutoffs or confidence calibration.
confidence.numerical_effect: none; no score multiplier or confidence percentage

dimensions.effect: Placement informs uncertainty. Pocket and other do not establish calibrated differential A/J/R reliability.
Movement informs uncertainty for all components, without a defensible relative-weight adjustment.
Road context does not justify suppressing measured disturbances or changing relative weights.
Traffic informs interpretation, not a stopping penalty or component discount.
Independent subjective description only; no self-report score reward.
Untimed reported maneuver does not verify directional braking or vehicle turning.
Unverified unusual-event metadata; no near-miss penalty, no invented timestamps.

context.rationale: No available questionnaire category identifies a calibrated, component-specific reliability effect. All category factors are neutral; interpretation/confidence changes only. No subjective reward or near-miss penalty.

missing_questionnaire: Baseline remains computable; contextual score unavailable for absent, incomplete, invalid, duplicate or mismatched feedback. Never assume an answer.

normalization.origin: Existing equal-trip-weighted empirical P95 magnitude references; reused as scale anchors, not safety limits
